structure: Retain the previously sealed scientific model and generator unchanged. One fixed joint law generates paired measurements for independent women. CHNS aggregates determine band probabilities and marginal parameters; rejection sampling adds within-band dependence without altering those margins. Supplied generated-only discrepancies are small and compatible with sampling variation, although no formal Monte Carlo discrepancy test was performed. They provide no basis for changing the unidentified within-band association.

parameter_provenance.source: Supplied CHNS A-only supplement, population description and Tables 1–2
parameter_provenance.population: Linked complete-case women aged 18–49 in evidence communities, regardless of pregnancy or inflammation; unweighted.
parameter_provenance.measurement: Central whole-blood Hb, g/dL; uncorrected serum ferritin, micrograms/L. No adjustment variables.
parameter_provenance.reported_values_used: Band counts 206, 619, 298; depleted counts 123, 148, 59; Hb means and SDs and ferritin geometric means and geometric SDs exactly as entered in model_spec.
parameter_provenance.use: Counts define mixture and depletion probabilities. Scaled-beta and shifted-gamma parameters match Hb band means and variances. Two positive scales for log ferritin match each band's log mean, log variance and probability below 15.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Sample summaries are fixed population plug-in parameters. No confidence intervals for these aggregates were supplied, and parameter uncertainty is not propagated.

parameter_provenance.source: Zhu et al., 2010, DOI 10.1024/0300-9831/a000014, Methods pp. 145–146 and Table III p. 150
parameter_provenance.population: Separate June 2004 rural Hebei sample of 1,671 selected nonpregnant, nonlactating mothers using IUD contraception, predominantly aged 25–35, with health and supplement exclusions.
parameter_provenance.measurement: Hemocue Hb and plasma ferritin. Table III compares Hb bands below 100, 100–119 and at least 120 g/L without covariate adjustment.
parameter_provenance.reported_values_used: Ferritin geometric means 1.3, 5.9 and 22.3 micrograms/L across increasing Hb bands.
parameter_provenance.use: Qualitative support for positive association, especially at low Hb. Hebei observations are not pooled with CHNS. The article's adjusted anemia OR is not substituted for the requested crude OR.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Selection, assays, year and population differ. Reported intervals are not interpreted as individual SDs or used as calibration weights.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Within-band density-kernel coefficients 0.9, 0.6 and 0.2; beta-score powers 8 and 1; centered exponential upper-band Hb score; tanh normal-latent score.
parameter_provenance.use: Imposes positive residual association that weakens at higher Hb while preserving fitted margins. These coefficients are neither correlations nor odds ratios.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Within-band dependence is not identified by the supplied tables. No numerical Spearman estimate is available from either evidence source.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Scaled-beta Hb below 14, shifted-gamma Hb above 14, threshold-anchored two-piece-normal log ferritin, and unchanged transfer of CHNS evidence-community parameters.
parameter_provenance.use: Defines one positive continuous joint distribution for other communities under the same CHNS design.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Within-band shapes, tails and transportability remain unverified.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted crude odds ratio
requested_estimands.definition: Odds of hb_g_dl <12 among ferritin_ug_l <15 divided by those among ferritin_ug_l >=15.
requested_estimands.support: The model's population OR is the CHNS Table 1 plug-in value 123*710/(83*207), approximately 5.083. Finite-sample estimates vary and may be undefined in small cohorts.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted Spearman rank correlation
requested_estimands.definition: Correlation of ranks of continuous, uncorrected Hb and ferritin on the same generated women.
requested_estimands.support: Between-band association is informed by CHNS. Within-band association remains assumption-dependent. The supplied feedback does not validate Spearman correlation.

limitations: The most consequential remaining assumption is within-band dependence: many joint distributions reproduce every supplied aggregate but yield different Spearman correlations. Positive association weakening at higher Hb is a nominated assumption, not an identified result.
Evidence-community summaries are transported unchanged to other CHNS communities. Community heterogeneity and clustering are not modeled; people are independent as requested.
Pregnancy, inflammation, age, geography and other anemia determinants are not explicitly generated. Their aggregate contributions are absorbed into the two-variable distribution.
Band boundaries create artificial density changes, and extrapolated tails are unverified. Neither inflammation nor altitude correction is applied.
Repeated seeds describe sampling variation under the fixed law, not uncertainty about evidence, structure or transport. Neither requested association has a causal interpretation.

results: Band counts sum to 1123; depleted counts sum to 330; 148+59=207 and the remaining nonanemic nondepleted count is 710, agreeing with Table 1.
The Table 1 crude OR is approximately 5.083.
Centered bounded Hb scores and the odd tanh normal score preserve both margins under the rejection density; dependence coefficients have absolute value below one.

checks_actually_performed.type: Controller-supplied generated-only feedback for the previously sealed candidate
checks_actually_performed.scope: Comparison with original CHNS A tables only; not held-out validation. Seed and execution sample size were not explicitly supplied. The complete numerical report is retained below in compact tabular form.
checks_actually_performed.interpretation: The report supports numerical reproduction of the fitted aggregate constraints. It does not identify within-band dependence or establish target-community validity.

checks_actually_performed.result: The unchanged synchronous generator reads spec['model'] and spec['task']['n_rows'], uses seed-controlled randomness and allowed dependencies, and returns the three requested columns without finite-sample moment enforcement or seed selection.
No new execution, validation adapter, source-check adapter or literature retrieval was available or performed in this revision. No additional source statistic was supplied.
